pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WHY AREN'T YOU IN CLASS, HACHIKEN?!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I ALREADY TALKED TO ALL THE TEACHERS ABOUT IT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I FIGURED THAT YOU MIGHT TRY AND SNEAK IN HERE TO GET YOUR STUFF WHEN NOBODY WAS AROUND, SO I WAITED FOR YOU TO SHOW UP AND I WAS RIGHT!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BUT YOUR MOM STILL WANTS YOU TO FINISH HIGH SCHOOL, WHY ARE YOU SO STUBBORN ABOUT WORKING?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THOUGH I ALREADY HAVE, TO BE COMPLETELY HONEST.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WHEN MY OLD MAN TOOK OUT HIS LOAN TO EXPAND THE FARM, HE ASKED THEM TO BE HIS CO-SIGNER.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF ANYBODY WERE TO GET HURT BECAUSE OF SOMETHING THEY DID FOR ME, I'D FEEL AWFUL ABOUT IT...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THAT'S WHY, EVEN IF IT'S ONLY A LITTLE, I HAVE TO HELP PAY BACK WHAT WE OWE AS FAST AS WE CAN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: OUR FARM IS PRETTY FAR UP IN THE MOUNTAINS, SO THE LAND ISN'T VERY EASY TO GROW ON. EVEN IF WE TRIED TO SELL IT ALL OFF, WE WOULDN'T MAKE MUCH.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: OUR COWS ARE PRETTY OLD AS WELL, SO I DONT BELIEVE THEY WOULD SELL FOR MUCH EITHER.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WHAT ABOUT ALL YOUR DREAMS? ARE YOU JUST GOING TO GIVE UP?!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU'VE WORKED SO HARD TO GET THIS FAR!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I WANT MY LITTLE SISTERS TO BE ABLE TO GO TO COLLEGE...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU'RE RIGHT... BASEBALL... TAKING OVER THE FARM...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THIS IS THE LAST OF IT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THANK YOU FOR THAT BACON YOU SENT US!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HACHIKEN-KUN... BE SURE TO FINISH SCHOOL, OKAY?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BE SURE TO DROP BY FROM TIME TO TIME.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF YOU KEEP WORRYING ABOUT OTHERS SO MUCH, YOU AREN'T GOING TO LIVE VERY LONG.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THINGS LIKE THIS HAPPEN ALL THE TIME.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I'VE ALREADY COME TO ACCEPT IT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SO JUST LET IT BE, ALREADY.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: TRYING TO ACT ALL COOL AND COMPOSED BECAUSE YOU'VE ACCEPTED THE REALITY OF THINGS...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: DON'T GIVE ME THAT CRAP, YOU IDIOT...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: PUTTING ON A FAKE SMILE AND ACTING LIKE YOU'RE FINE...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ALL YOU EVER SAY IS 'THAT'S HOW THINGS ARE,' OR 'IT CAN'T BE HELPED.'

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: STOP SPITTING OUT THAT BULLSHIT SO EASILY!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: EVEN THOUGH YOU'RE BOILING OVER ON THE INSIDE!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BECAUSE I ABSOLUTELY HATE IT WHEN YOU SAY CRAP LIKE THAT!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: CAME BY TO GET HIS THINGS TODAY.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I TOLD HIM NOT TO WORRY ABOUT US, BUT YOU KNOW ICHIRO-CHAN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THAT'S WHY... HE SAID HE HAS TO DROP OUT TO WORK...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SO LET'S JUST NOT TALK ABOUT THIS ANYMORE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF HE ALREADY EXPLAINED EVERYTHING, THAT MAKES IT EASIER.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THAT'S JUST THE WAY THINGS ARE...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I DON'T WANT YOU TO BE BURDENED BY THIS.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU CAN'T TELL ME HOW I'M ALLOWED TO FEEL ABOUT THIS...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THIS IS THE CLUB WHERE NUTCRACKER HAS BEEN APPEARING RECENTLY...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HIDDEN MEANING: RE-APPROACH, THERE ARE ALSO THE PUNS 'AFRO' AND 'BLOOD SHALL OVERFLOW'.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SENSEI, HAVE YOU EVER BEEN TO A PLACE LIKE THIS BEFORE...?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I DID AN INVESTIGATION WITH AKIRA-SAN IN A PLACE LIKE THIS ONCE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I DESPERATIVELY STOPPED AKIRA-SAN WHEN SHE SAID 'ONLY ONE DRINK'

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: DO ALL OF US... NO, PFFFIT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: RATHER, SAIKO, YOU BITCH, THE DIFFERENCE IN TOORU AND ME IS WEIRD, AIN'T IT!!?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: PLEASE THINK OF THE TALL GIRLS. LIKE A DELMO.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: TAN: SAIKO SWITCHES AROUND THE HIRAGANA OF 'MODEL'. MIGHT BE A REFERENCE OF MR. CHILDREN'S SONG 'PERUMO'.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SINCE PEOPLE WILL BE LOOKING AT YOUR FACE, IT'S MORE AMUSING IF YOU HAVE THAT HEAVY MAKE-UP ON... YOU WON'T BE FOUND OUT, SQUAD LEADER.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WE'RE GOING TO MAKE UP FOR OUR FAILURE THE OTHER DAY. SET YOURSELF FREE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AND WHAT'S UP WITH YOU, SASAN!!? YOU DID IT ON YOUR OWN!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THERE ARE TARGETS WITH AN EXTREMELY HIGH LEVEL OF DIFFICULTY AND THERE ARE ALSO TARGETS THAT ARE EASY.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: NUTCRACKER HASN'T YET REACHED THE QUOTA SHE WAS GIVEN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I THINK, HOWEVER, THERE ARE A CONSIDERABLE NUMBER OF REQUESTS FOR TEENAGE TO 20S AGED "FEMALES".

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT LOOKS LIKE THAT PERSON IS GOING TO SUCCEED HER IF SHE FOLLOW LURING OUT ONE PERSON IN THIS PLACE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I GET THE FEELING THAT YOU ARE BEING SOFT ON HER...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU GOT SOME REASON FOR THAT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WITH THE SUPPORT OF HER LOVER, HER MOTHER STARTED A SNACK BAR.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HOWEVER, IT SEEMS THAT SHE WASN'T VERY SKILLED AT MANAGING IT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: JOINED THE CHEAP-IN-TUITION CCG ACADEMY JUNIOR SCHOOL.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHE DID TERRIBLY IN HER CLASSWORK AND THE PRACTICAL SKILLS SECTION.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ORIGINALLY, SINCE SHE HAD NO INTENTION OF BECOMING A GHOUL INVESTIGATOR.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHE PISSED THE TEACHER OFF SO MUCH...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WHILE SHE STILL HAD NO INTENTION OF BECOMING A GHOUL INVESTIGATOR.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AS THE TIME WHEN EVERYONE WOULD CHOOSE THEIR CAREER PATHS APPROACHED.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AMONG THE SIX WHO POSSESSED THE 'APTITUDE', SAIKO-CHAN WAS BY FAR THE ONE WITH THE HIGHEST 'APTITUDE'.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ...I HAVE TO MENTOR SAIKO-CHAN BECAUSE OF MY POSITION.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AND OF COURSE, I PLAN TO DO THAT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HER MOTHER, WHO KNEW ABOUT THE COMPENSATION PAYMENTS, IMMEDIATELY AGREED TO THIS SURGERY.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT SEEMS THAT THE EXPLANATION OF THE RISKS INVOLVED NEVER REACHED HER MOTHER'S EARS...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I CAN'T HELP BUT THINK HOW IT'D BE

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: TO FORCE ANYMORE THAN THIS ON HER...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: FOR SAIKO-CHAN, WHO RECEIVED THE QS SURGERY WITHOUT HER OWN VOLITION, WHO BECAME AN INVESTIGATOR WITHOUT ANY INTENTION OF DOING SO,

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: JUST BECAUSE YOU HAVE PARENTS DOESN'T MEAN YOU'LL BE HAPPY, HUH?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ME TOO... MY FATHER WAS LIKE THAT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AS FOR TOORU... HIS WHOLE FAMILY WAS KILLED BY A GHOUL.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF SHE'S GOT MONEY PROBLEMS THEN SHE SHOULD WORK AND EARN A LIVING...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BUT, SEEING THAT SHE HAS 'THAT FAMILY' DON'T YOU THINK SHE SHOULD WORK MORE?!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THEN SHE SHOULD CUT TIES WITH HER MOM AFTER A WHILE, AIN'T THAT RIGHT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ALL SHE EVER DOES IS LAZE AROUND!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU ARE DIFFERENT FROM SAIKO AND US, AREN'T YOU?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF THAT WERE ME, I'D BE... YOU 'DON'T KNOW ANYTHING'. IT'S NOT ABOUT WHETHER YOU 'HAVE OR DON'T HAVE PARENTS,'

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF YOU WEREN'T AROUND ANYMORE, THAT DUMBASS URIE WOULD BE COCKY...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: OH MAN, THAT HAIR-STYLE IS GREAT!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ...THAT'S RIGHT. SORRY FOR SAYING SOMETHING WEIRD...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I ALSO WANT TO EARN AND BECOME SOMETHING LIKE THAT

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT SEEMS MUCHANKO HAS BEEN DRINKING SOMETHING.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WAIT, HE'S STILL A BIT UNDERAGE, ISN'T HE... WHAT IS HE DOING...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WITH THIS, WE CAN INFILTRATE THEM AFTER ALL...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I ALSO PERFECTLY GOT THE CONTACT ADDRESS FROM HER!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I WAS INVITED BY HER FOR A 'PART-TIME JOB' JUST NOW...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I'M GOING TO DANCE. A VICTORY DANCE!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: TOORU... COME BACK HERE!!! YOU'RE DOING A GREAT JOB, MUCCHAN!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SAIKO, GO, GO, HERE WE GO.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHIRAZU-KUN, YOUR DANCE IS OLD AS BALLS!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I WONDER IF I WILL DIE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IS THAT THE RUMORED ONE? THE RUMORED ONE?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: DOESN'T THAT HAPPY LOOKING FACE PISS YOU OFF?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THE ATMOSPHERE AROUND HIM HAS CHANGED, AND FURTHERMORE, HE'S WEARING GIRL'S CLOTHES.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: LIKE THE 'I WILL NOT LOSE TO TRAGEDY!' TYPE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: KANEKI-SAMA'S AGONIZED WRITHING FORM AS HE WAS COMPLETELY SUBMERGED IN THE BOG OF TRAGEDY WAS BEAUTIFUL...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT'S SUCH A LAME GROOVE. ROMA FEELS SO.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AND RETURN THAT BEAUTIFUL WHITE KANEKI BACK TO ME...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HE SHOULD HURRY UP AND SURRENDER THAT BODY

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT'D BE OKAY IF HAISE DIED, RIGHT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ...BUT... YOU REALLY DO WHATSOEVER YOU FEEL LIKE...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT SEEMS WE'LL GET TO SEE SOME INTERESTING THINGS, DOESN'T IT...?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THE SPIRIT TO CHALLENGE THE YOSHI-OKA... AND A QUICK TEMPER.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I FEARED NOTHING. I HAD NOTHING TO LOSE. YET I HAD MY FIGHTING SPIRIT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU WERE ABLE TO STEP INTO THAT PART OF MY LIFE NICELY, DENSHI-CHIRO.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I LAY RESTLESS FOR 3 DAYS AND 3 NIGHTS.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU'RE HALF A STEP FURTHER AWAY NOW... COMPARED TO BACK THEN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT'S BEEN A YEAR SINCE THEN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHALL WE CALL OFF THIS DUEL?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: JUST ENOUGH DISTANCE SO THAT HE CAN'T TOUCH ME.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SNOW THIS MUCH EVERY YEAR IN THE CAPITAL?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF YOU DON'T WANT TO FIGHT THE DUEL.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: A SWORD IS JUST A SHARP TOOL SOLELY FOR KILLING.
